description: This file defines types, classes, and functions for handling test reporting and result serialization in a Playwright testing environment. It includes classes for managing test suites, test cases, test results, and a receiver for processing JSON-based test events.

classes.name: TeleReporterReceiver
classes.description: Handles incoming JSON test events, manages test suite and test case objects, and communicates with a reporter to output test results.

classes.name: TeleSuite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, which can contain nested suites and test cases, with methods for managing hierarchy and retrieving test information.

classes.name: TeleTestCase
classes.description: Represents an individual test case, including its results, location, and metadata.

classes.name: TeleTestStep
classes.description: Represents a step within a test result, including timing, attachments, and errors.

classes.name: TeleTestResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome of a test execution, including status, duration, errors, and attachments.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Processes incoming JSON test event messages and routes them to appropriate handler methods.

methods.name: _onConfigure
methods.description: Handles configuration setup from a JSON event.

methods.name: _onProject
methods.description: Handles project-related JSON event, updating or creating project suites.

methods.name: _onBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of test execution.

methods.name: _onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the beginning of a test result.

methods.name: _onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles a paused test, updating errors.

methods.name: _onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test, recording results.

methods.name: _onStepBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test step.

methods.name: _onStepEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step.

methods.name: _onAttach
methods.description: Handles attachment data for a test result.

methods.name: _onError
methods.description: Handles error events.

methods.name: _onStdIO
methods.description: Handles standard IO data for a test result.

methods.name: _onEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of the entire test run.

methods.name: _onExit
methods.description: Handles process exit event.

methods.name: _parseConfig
methods.description: Converts JSON config to internal full config format.

methods.name: _parseProject
methods.description: Converts JSON project data to internal project representation.

methods.name: _parseAttachments
methods.description: Converts JSON attachments to internal format.

methods.name: _mergeSuiteInto
methods.description: Merges JSON suite data into internal suite objects.

methods.name: _mergeTestInto
methods.description: Merges JSON test case data into internal test case objects.

methods.name: _updateTest
methods.description: Updates test case object with JSON data.

methods.name: _absoluteLocation
methods.description: Converts relative location to absolute location based on root directory.

methods.name: _absolutePath
methods.description: Resolves relative path to absolute path using resolvePath or rootDir.
